environment.description: Same Node.js 18 Express application on EC2 behind ALB in us-east-1. The ALB has an associated AWS WAFv2 WebACL (regional scope) with the following rule groups in priority order: (1) AWS-AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet at priority 1 in COUNT mode for baseline telemetry, (2) a custom rule group 'ssrf-dns-rebind-protection' at priority 2 with a rate-based rule limiting to 5 requests per 5 minutes to /api/webhooks/verify per source IP, (3) AWS-AWSManagedRulesAmazonIpReputationList at priority 3 in BLOCK mode. Additionally, the EC2 instance has IMDSv2 enforced (HttpPutResponseHopLimit: 1, HttpTokens: required). VPC has a Network Firewall with a stateful rule group containing domain-based egress filtering that only permits outbound DNS resolution to Route 53 Resolver endpoints and blocks TCP connections to RFC 1918 and link-local (169.254.0.0/16) destination ranges from the application subnet. The combination of hop-limit=1 on IMDS plus Network Firewall egress blocking to internal ranges prevents the SSRF payload from reaching metadata or internal services even if DNS rebinding succeeds at the application layer.
